industry: Hair salons, barbershops, color specialists, and salon-spa hybrids (cuts, color, blowouts, smoothing treatments, bridal)
words_and_claims_to_avoid: 'Organic', 'toxin-free', 'chemical-free' color/smoothing without competent substantiation for the finished product/service as used (FTC s.5)

'Formaldehyde-free' keratin/Brazilian Blowout claims if the product releases formaldehyde when heated (FDA warning history; CA AG settlement with Brazilian Blowout) — disclose risks; never claim safe/free if false
Before/after photos presented as typical results without generally expected results (16 CFR 255.2); edited lighting/hair density that misleads; no guest authorization
'Free haircut' that requires buying a more expensive service without stating the regular price of the paid service and all conditions (16 CFR 251; 16 CFR 233)
'[X]% off any service' / '50% off' (GOLD-hair-salon-003/025/029) without a real regular price and offer period
'Color specialists' / medical-sounding repair claims ('regrows hair', 'cures damage') without truth and licensing
Multi-coupon grids that bury the real deal (Patrick directional preference: one clear offer) — legal if truthful, but often weaker creative
Guarantees of a specific look lasting 'forever' without conditions (16 CFR 239)
Children's images without parent written consent
compliance_notes: FTC Act s.5: service and product claims (including keratin/smoothing, organic, results) need substantiation before printing.

16 CFR 255 (2023 Endorsement Guides): testimonials and before/afters imply typical results; 'results not typical' is unlikely to cure; disclose generally expected results; material connections disclosed; real consumers.
16 CFR 251 ('Free') and 16 CFR 233 (deceptive pricing): free-with-purchase and percent-off need a bona fide regular price; state conditions with the offer.

FDA + OSHA history on hair-smoothing products that release formaldehyde when heated: do not advertise 'formaldehyde-free' or unqualified 'safe' if methylene glycol/formaldehyde releasers are present; train staff; follow OSHA hazard communication for workers (salon ops, reflected in consumer-facing honesty).
State cosmetology board rules: licensing claims, booth-renter advertising, and sometimes price advertising vary — client must confirm. Do not imply a booth renter is the salon entity if inaccurate.

Florida and other states may have specific free/discounted health-related ad rules; pure cosmetology hair services are usually outside Florida's 72-hour dental/medical free-offer statute, but hybrid med-spa/salon ads that include medical procedures inherit those rules (see med-spa-chiro.json).
Gift cards: state gift-card/escheat rules on expiration and fees; print material terms.
Automatic membership/loyalty renewals: ROSCA for online sign-up; California ARL (B&P 17602 / AB 2863) for auto-renew disclosures and cancellation — relevant if the salon sells memberships.
EDDM/new-mover lists: no deceptive 'official' neighbor notices (39 USC 3001).
standing_rules: Emotion-agnostic: pride, belonging, anticipation, even FOMO for event deadlines are fine when legal.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Gold multi-coupon grids (GOLD-hair-salon-001/017/026/032) vs roofing-round-5 directional preference for one photo + one offer + one QR
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Patrick's votes (directional) prefer single-offer clarity; coupon grids remain legal if truthful. Default to one hero offer; use grids only when the client insists or a test requires it.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: 'Formaldehyde-free' / 'safe' keratin & Brazilian Blowout style claims (market common; GOLD-hair-salon-009 lists Brazilian Blowout price) vs FDA/OSHA/CA AG history
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Compliance wins: never claim formaldehyde-free or unqualified safe if the product can release formaldehyde when heated; price the service only with honest product disclosures.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Vendor ROI claims (PostcardMania Fantastic Sams / Hair By Katy; Salon Today Pyara) vs evidence rules
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Label agency-only unverified; do not print ROI on client mailers as proof.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Before/after transformation creative vs 16 CFR 255 typical-results rule
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Compliance wins: authorized real guests only; disclose generally expected results; prefer outcome-feeling photos over miraculous composites.
